summary: A one page guestbook: a form to sign it and the list of entries, saved in Supabase
assumptions: Entries are public and cannot be edited or deleted

ui_elements.label: Message
ui_elements.purpose: What the visitor wants to say

ui_elements.label: Entries
ui_elements.purpose: Everything visitors have written, newest first

features.name: Sign the guestbook
features.description: A form with a name and a message; both are required

acceptance_criteria.statement: The name and message inputs and the button are visible
A signed entry appears in the list and is still there after a reload

features.name: Read the guestbook
features.description: Lists every entry with its name and message, newest first

acceptance_criteria.statement: The entries list is visible when the page opens

tables.name: guestbook_entries
access_rules: Nobody can change or delete entries

risks.mitigation: Length limits in the table and the form

files.purpose: The entries table and its access rules

visual_design: A warm paper coloured page with the form on top and entries below as simple notes.
